title: THE LOST KIND: Son of Monsters
synopsis: Raised by monsters in a hidden civilization beyond the human world, a man has only ever known them as family. When human soldiers and a mysterious hooded sorcerer breach the forest, he must face the danger before him — and the power hidden within.

audienceReactions.quote: This is why Hollywood should be nervous!
audienceReactions.author: @BrianHays-k6k

audienceReactions.quote: The production value on these AI movies are just so truly staggering it's unbelievable
audienceReactions.author: @kjp8713

audienceReactions.quote: So damn well cut and editted, holy shit! It still has some voice-pacing issues, which is super common with neural based voices... but sheesh, it has LOTR vibes, Star Wars vibes all over it
